$description: ui-geometry's symbols and words: one meaning each. names are what the scripts emit (symbol:, alias:, id:, role:, preset:, tier:, flag:, file:); `node scripts/terms.mjs --check` keeps them in step. avoid explains a use to stay away from; avoidExact lists exact phrases that are always wrong, which the same check refuses in SKILL.md and the references.

principles.rule: A symbol or word names one concept.
principles.why: A letter read two ways (T as text edge and as hit target) gives two right-looking answers to one question.

principles.rule: When a letter is taken, the newer meaning takes a subscript (T_hit, B_α, D_f).

concepts.definition: The scope's font size in px; F = n is the control text size.
concepts.intent: The one input every length derives from.

concepts.definition: The unit: q = a_q·n + b_q (standard preset: n/2 − 3px, so 4px at 14).
concepts.intent: Every length is a multiple of q.
aliases: a_q, b_q (the unit's slope and offset)
avoid: a, b for the unit constants (a is an icon size, b a border)

concepts.definition: Border width in px; it sits inside the box, so padding becomes d − b and radius R − b.
concepts.intent: Keeping depth measured from the outer edge.
concepts.not: Not the unit offset b_q.

concepts.definition: A text style whose size is s_t = F + m_t·q and line height s_t + k_t·q.
concepts.intent: One type scale tied to q.
concepts.not: Not a length role (fit) and not a colour role (ui-colors).

concepts.definition: Font ascent, descent, cap height and average advance, as fractions of the em.
concepts.intent: Optical text centring and the reading measure.
avoid: A, D, c for font metrics (D is the composite edge)

concepts.definition: compact, default or loose; reaches spacing only through I.
concepts.intent: One switch for how tight a scope is.

concepts.definition: The control inset per density (standard preset 1 / 1.5 / 2 q).
concepts.intent: The one length density changes.

concepts.definition: The fixed control gutter (½q): label gaps, separators, the inline control's inset.
concepts.intent: Spacing that never follows density.

concepts.definition: The control margin, I − g_c.
concepts.intent: The inset of an option inside a host.

concepts.definition: The slot (5q): the box that holds a label line or an icon.
concepts.intent: A fixed content height inside every control.

concepts.definition: The control height, S + 2I; also every list and table row.
concepts.intent: The height buttons, inputs and rows share.

concepts.definition: The inline height, S + 2g_c (24 at 14px): chips and tags.
concepts.intent: A smaller control that keeps S.

concepts.definition: h + 2: a card's title bar or region band.
concepts.intent: Title bars and region bands, named by one symbol.
concepts.not: Not the elevation alpha budget (B_α) and not a breakpoint (W_j).

concepts.definition: 2I: where text sits from the edge of a control, menu row, list row or table edge cell.
concepts.intent: One left edge for text in a stack.
concepts.not: Not a hit target (T_hit).

concepts.definition: I/2: the padding of a composite.
concepts.intent: Padding inside a composite control.
concepts.not: Not the font descent (D_f).

concepts.definition: An icon's size: sm = F, md 4q, lg 4.5q, full = S.
concepts.intent: Icons that centre in one S box.
concepts.not: Not the unit slope a_q.

concepts.definition: Curvature in [0, 1] per tier: square 0, soft κ_s (¾), pill 1.
concepts.intent: One dial for roundness per tier.

concepts.definition: The control radius r(κ_control); r_o = r − m_c for an option in a host, r_s = r − I for a key cap in the slot.
concepts.intent: Concentric corners within the control tier.

concepts.definition: An unframed checkbox, radio or switch, a badge: sized from a.md and S, density-free.
concepts.intent: Choices on the content edge.

concepts.definition: The gap between sibling controls: 0, g_c, m_c or min(cap, I).
concepts.intent: Action rows and hosted controls.

concepts.definition: A control's block padding I.
concepts.intent: Measuring a control's vertical padding.

concepts.definition: Focus ring width w and offset o; outer radius r + o + w.
concepts.intent: A ring concentric with the control.

concepts.definition: An accessibility floor in px (24 pointer, 44 touch), not a multiple of q.
concepts.intent: Checking geometry against target size without scaling it.
avoid: T for a hit target (T is the text edge)

concepts.definition: A button inside an input: an item h − 2d_c, inset d_c, radius r − d_c.
concepts.intent: Steppers, clear buttons and addons that match segments.

concepts.definition: Snapping I and g_c to whole px and S to even px at n, then depths and gaps to whole px.
concepts.intent: Whole-pixel lengths at any n.

concepts.definition: A listbox, menu or select popup: a frame padded d_c around items.
concepts.intent: Popups whose item plus padding is h.
concepts.not: Not a card, and not the card depth ladder.

concepts.definition: The padding of a control frame or segmented host (standard preset ¾q); also a popup's offset from its trigger.
concepts.intent: One padding for menus, listboxes and segmented controls.

concepts.definition: An item in a frame or host: h − 2d_c (26 at 14px), corner r_frame − d_c.
concepts.intent: Menu rows, segments, tabs, hosted controls.

concepts.definition: A segmented control or tab list: h tall, padded d_c, holding joined items.
concepts.intent: Segments that share a frame.

concepts.definition: The gap between rows or segments: 0, g_c or a level gutter.
concepts.intent: Lists without extra spacing.

concepts.definition: A table cell's inline padding I; edge cells pad T.
concepts.intent: Tables that align with buttons.

concepts.definition: A menu or listbox item's inline padding T − d_c, so its text sits at T.
concepts.intent: Menu text where the select shows its value.

concepts.definition: A card's padding from the ladder 0…9; it moves 2·ΔI per density step.
concepts.intent: Cards that follow density.

concepts.definition: A card's corner: d + min(r(κ_card), soft).
concepts.intent: Card corners concentric with their content.

concepts.definition: A popover's padding, ¾d snapped to ½q.
concepts.intent: Popovers between a frame and a card.

concepts.definition: A dialog's padding, 1½d snapped to ½q.
concepts.intent: Dialogs deeper than cards.

concepts.definition: Nesting fraction: a child card has depth (1 − f)·d and radius R − f·d.
concepts.intent: Nested cards that conserve depth.

concepts.definition: A gap inside a card: d/4, d/2 − I (under a painted, flush title band), d/2 or d (between groups, under a header, before actions).
concepts.intent: Groups, blocks, title and actions.

concepts.definition: A card of controls at d = 2I.
concepts.intent: A tool panel.
concepts.not: Not the layout level ℓ_panel and not the 72q panel width.
avoid: panel, alone, where a level or width is meant

concepts.definition: A shadow of L layers in a geometric series at a level s (raised ½, popup 1, floating 1½, modal 2).
concepts.intent: Height read as halo size, not darkness.
concepts.not: Not paint: ui-materials owns the shadow's colour and its use by relief.

concepts.definition: One layer k = 0 (contact) … L − 1 of an elevation shadow.
concepts.intent: Counting and spacing shadow layers.
concepts.not: Not a ui-materials layer (base or overlay).

concepts.definition: The sum of a shadow's layer alphas (0.19 light, 0.45 dark), the same at every level.
concepts.intent: Shadows that don't darken with height.
avoid: B for the budget (B is the title bar)

concepts.definition: light or dark: picks the alpha budget (`--scheme`).
concepts.intent: Darker shadows on dark grounds.
concepts.not: Same meaning as ui-colors' scheme (polarity); ui-colors' modes (dim, contrast) map to their scheme.

concepts.definition: A multiplier of I per level: composite ½, group 1, collection 2, panel 2, page 4.
concepts.intent: Insets that grow from a part to the page.
concepts.not: Not an elevation level (s). The preset key `levels` is this set; `elevation.levels` is the other.

concepts.definition: The page margin, ℓ_page·I = 4I. A preset may step ℓ_page by page width (narrow, base, wide at `marginSteps`); where text is held to a measure the visible margin is what the measure leaves, never less than M.
concepts.intent: The page edge.

concepts.definition: The gap between cards or grid columns, M/2.
concepts.intent: Grid gutters.
concepts.not: Not gap(relation), the gap function of section 7.

concepts.definition: A grid for several column counts: a field of U units with a gutter and a margin of g units each, so the page is U + 2g units and the page unit u = W / (U + 2g), snapped to the device grid. n columns fill the field when n divides U + g.
concepts.intent: One field that holds passages of 1–6, 10 and 12 columns (U = 58, g = 2).
concepts.not: Not q (u is the page's own unit, W over the unit count), not g_c (g counts page units), and not the single-count grid of M, G and w.

concepts.definition: A block of headings, text, actions and cards padded 3¼F above and below, 0 at the sides, its contents spaced by the flow gaps.
concepts.intent: Sections that share the page edge.

concepts.definition: A vertical gap between a kicker, a heading, paragraphs, actions and a note running down a page section, a multiple of the body size F: 1, 1¼, 1¼, 2½, 1.
concepts.intent: Prose and its actions spaced by the text, the same at every density.
concepts.not: Not a gap from the gap rule (half a container's padding), which stands inside cards, popovers, dialogs, panels and regions.

concepts.definition: A floating surface's width: min(max(w_a, min(content, maximum)), W − 2·viewport margin), with w_a the width of the control that opens and fills it, or 0. Its height h_f is min(content, H − 2·viewport margin).
concepts.intent: Popovers that fit the viewport.
avoid: surface, alone (ui-colors: the neutral family of cards; ui-materials avoids the word and says part)

concepts.definition: The width at which j columns of at least w_min first fit: j·w_min + (j − 1)·G + 2M.
concepts.intent: Container breakpoints in q.

concepts.definition: Characters per line (45 / 66 / 75); width N_ch·w̄·F.
concepts.intent: Reading width checked in characters, not q.

concepts.definition: One of four groups that own their constants and κ: controls, collections, containers, layout.
concepts.intent: Fitting, tuning or adopting one group alone.
concepts.not: Not a ui-materials layer or relief.

concepts.definition: A set of constants (`PRESETS.standard` or a JSON file); the equations never change.
concepts.intent: Bringing another system.
concepts.not: The standard preset is the default, not the system. Not a ui-materials preset (a material) or a ui-colors request preset.

concepts.definition: What a measured length is (height, frame-depth, …), which fixes the target it is compared with.
concepts.intent: Fitting a project tier by tier.
concepts.not: Not a colour role (ui-colors) or a type role.

concepts.definition: Every container's padding, gap, radius and height, inside out (`--containers`, equations › 19).
concepts.intent: One table to lay out any container.

concepts.definition: The content and geometry a specimen sheet must follow (`references/showcase.md`).
concepts.intent: Proving the system on one page.
concepts.not: Not the canvas, packing or checks: ui-showcase-bento owns those. A ui-showcase-bento group is a tile, not a layout level.

concepts.definition: A container's own padding, whichever container it is: d in a card, d_p in a popover, d_d in a dialog, (1 − f)·d in a nested card, ℓ·I in a layout band.
concepts.intent: Writing the gap rule once: p/2 between blocks, p before actions.
concepts.not: Not a second card depth: in a card, p is d.

concepts.definition: A side of a box, where the box ends or its content starts: the control edge, a card's content edge, the page edge.
concepts.intent: Naming where a length is measured from.
concepts.not: Not ui-materials' bevel (a lighting pass on a raised part). The text edge T and the composite edge D are lengths measured from an edge.

concepts.definition: A named character (instrument, product, marketing, civic, editorial, fashion, calm, toy, terminal) held as a profile: for each observable, the band its measured pages fall in, with dials that land inside the bands a preset can reach.
concepts.intent: Asking for a character by name, or saying which one a fitted project is nearest.
concepts.not: Not a preset: many presets belong to one archetype, and a preset is scored against it, never equal to it. Not a ui-materials material or a ui-colors theme.

concepts.definition: An observable's 25th percentile, median and 75th percentile over an archetype's pages. A profile is an archetype's bands taken together. Distance is how far a value lies outside a band, over the observable's spread across all pages, capped at 3 and averaged over the observables given.
concepts.intent: Scoring a preset or a page without requiring it to sit inside every band.
concepts.not: Not a range a value must satisfy, and not a painted band (a title band or region band).

concepts.definition: Control height over the font size: (S + 2I)·q / n. 2 / 2.29 / 2.57 with the standard insets at n = 14. The file's observable `loft`.
concepts.intent: Comparing control height across systems whose n differs.

concepts.definition: One measured ratio, count or length of a rendered page, named as in `references/archetypes.json`: 63 from one evaluation of the page observer, 9 more from a screenshot or a second load.
concepts.intent: Scoring a real page against the archetypes with the same measures the profiles were built from.
concepts.not: Not a length role (what the fitter compares) and not a constant: nothing is derived from an observable.

concepts.definition: A second rule some systems use beside the hairline b: a bar beside an inset note, under a header band or above a list of related links. It is I wide.
concepts.intent: Marking a note or a band off with one weight that scales with the unit.
concepts.not: Not a border weight for fields or cards, which stay b, and not a focus ring.

concepts.definition: Letter spacing on a label, in ems of the label's size F_l. It adds τ·F_l after every letter, so a label of c letters is c·τ·F_l wider and its trailing τ·F_l is taken back to keep the text inset T on both sides.
concepts.intent: Tracked capitals that stay centred in their control.
concepts.not: Not kerning (pairs of letters, the typeface's own), and not the text inset T.

concepts.definition: A group of archetypes the measured pages do not separate into distinct groups: application (instrument, product), expressive (marketing, calm, toy), reading (editorial, civic); fashion and terminal are each their own. An archetype's `near` lists those it cannot be told from.
concepts.intent: Naming what a page is nearest without claiming a distinction the measurements do not support.
concepts.not: Not a typeface family, and not a ui-colors colour family.

concepts.definition: A dimension is one of the nine principal components the measured pages vary along; six are named (richness, body size, colour, white space, text cover, lightness). A page's position is its score on each, in standard deviations of the measured pages, from at least 40 of the 66 observables used.
concepts.intent: Saying where a page or a kit sits when it lies between archetypes.
concepts.not: Not a CSS position, not a dial (nothing is derived from a position), and not an archetype: an archetype is the nearest named region, a position is the coordinates.

concepts.definition: The vertical module of a preset whose rhythm is 'line': L, the body line as an even px that divides by 4, and its half. Text lines, gaps, control boxes and rows are multiples of the half-line; a heading keeps its own line and its block is padded to the grid.
concepts.intent: One rhythm down the page that can be seen, where line heights by formula share no module.
concepts.not: Not the q baseline grid (a check on the formula's lines), and not the page grid of columns.
